copied.description: Transient confirmation after a copy-to-clipboard action.

corsIntro.message: In production the API's CORS is origin-restricted. Add this extension's origin to the API's EXTENSION_ORIGINS allowlist (comma-separated) and restart the API. In development any origin is reflected, so this only matters in production.
corsIntro.description: Explains why the extension origin must be added to EXTENSION_ORIGINS.

finish.description: Onboarding stepper: finish setup on the last step.

hintApiKeyScopes.description: Hint under the API key field describing the scopes it needs.

hintDefaultDomain.message: New links are created under this domain. Required — the API rejects a create with an empty domain.
hintDefaultDomain.description: Hint under the default domain field.

hideKey.description: Toggle button label to hide the API key value.

labelApiBaseUrl.description: Label for the API base URL input.

labelDefaultDomain.description: Label for the default short domain input.

next.description: Onboarding stepper: advance to the next step.

onboardingDone.message: You're all set. This extension is ready to shorten links.
onboardingDone.description: Message shown when onboarding completes with a green verdict.

onboardingTitle.description: Title of the first-run onboarding view.

optionsIntro.description: Intro paragraph on the options page.

save.description: Save button label on the options form.

saved.description: Confirmation shown after settings are saved.

sectionConnection.description: Options section heading: API connection settings.

sectionCors.description: Options section heading: CORS / extension origin.

sectionDefaults.description: Options section heading: default link settings.

shortcutsIntro.message: Change the keyboard shortcut at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

showKey.description: Toggle button label to reveal the API key value.

stepApiKeyBody.message: Paste a snap_live_… key from the dashboard Developers page. It needs links:read and links:write; domains:read for the domain picker.

stepApiUrlBody.message: Enter the origin of your SnapURL API — no trailing /api/v1.

stepCorsBody.message: Add the origin below to your API's EXTENSION_ORIGINS, restart the API, then test the connection. A green result finishes setup.

testConnection.description: Button label to run a live connection test.

testing.description: Transient status while a connection test is in flight.

verdictAuth.message: Your API key was rejected (401/403). Check the key and its scopes.

verdictGeneric.message: The API responded with an error. See the message above.

verdictNeedsConfig.message: Enter an API base URL and key first.

verdictNetwork.message: Couldn't reach the API. If this is a production API, add this extension's origin (below) to EXTENSION_ORIGINS and restart it.

verdictOk.message: Connected. Your key works and can reach the API.
